summary: Deep winter. Eat from stores, plan the year, order seeds.
Still frozen. Chillies, onions and leeks start indoors under lights.
Peak indoor sowing. Snow lingers and beds stay frozen.
Soil thaws from ~20 April. Onion sets, first hardy sowings, chit potatoes.
Plant potatoes. Tender crops go out once frost passes, late May.
Long light, fast growth. Weed, feed, train tomatoes.
Peak season. Water, pick, lift garlic.
Main harvest. Sow green manure, order autumn sets.
First frosts from ~20 Sept. Plant garlic, harvest and cure for storage.
Clear and mulch beds; store the last crops before the freeze.
Hard frosts begin. Greenhouse empty, garden put to bed.
Dark and frozen. Eat from stores, plan next year, dream of seeds.
